mechanism:
Edit the scene tree, not the schedule or the no-go zone. At run time, identify the two unfinished navigating-agent goals whose arrival tolerances lie entirely inside the persistent zone, then relocate their associated movable assembly geometry—or a containing scene-tree subtree, including the whole build if necessary—so each required goal has a collision-free, navigably reachable arrival region outside the zone.

Preserve the scene-tree relationships needed by the affected work and do not create any new unreachable required goal. The exact relocation method and displacement are open; only the resulting reachability is required. The schedule DAG and assignment edges remain unchanged, and the harness performs its normal MILP reassignment afterward.

Preconditions: the blocked goals correspond to geometry represented on a movable scene-tree branch, and a valid reachable placement exists. The edit consumes intervention time and movement energy but no body spare. The scene-tree transform is reversible before subsequent physical work depends on the new placement; after such work proceeds, reversal may require moving that work as well.
impl_code:
function relocate_blocked_work_geometry!(env)
    zone_keys = [first(zone) for zone in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zone_keys) && error("no active restriction zone is available for relocation")

    before = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    if before.n_blocked != 0
        relocation = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
        if !(relocation.status in (:translated, :already_clear))
            restaging = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
            if restaging.status in (:restaged_all, :partial)
                relocation = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
            end
        end

        after = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
        if after.n_blocked != 0 || after.project_blocked
            error("scene-tree relocation left required navigating goals unreachable")
        end
    end

    return (; status = :success)
end
